name: Venomancer: Weaver Form is saved with the character and not announced again after a relog (#10514)
contract: Issue #10514 reports that Weaver Form reappears on the action bar at every login. AscensionVenomancer Refresh grants the form 804980 while the talent 706940 is known. It used Player::learnSpell(spell, true), a temporary grant: PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY spells are skipped when the character is saved (Player.cpp 'skip temporary spells'), so each login granted the form again, sent SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL for it and the client placed it on the bar as a new spell. The form is now a persisted grant: one SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL when the talent is learned, none after the character reloads from the database, and it is still removed together with the talent. spellbook_learned_alerts counts SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL packets for the spell over the whole scenario.

steps.label: SETUP: the talent grants Weaver Form
SETUP: the client was told about Weaver Form once
Let Refresh run after the login
Weaver Form is still known after the relog
DISCRIMINATING: the relog does not announce Weaver Form again
REGRESSION: Weaver Form leaves with the talent
